name: MSSADLinear: multi-scale slope + spectral
tagline: DLinear scaled to 4 trend/seasonal scales (k=3,7,13,25), each trend blends a linear head with explicit slope extrapolation; an extra learnable spectral-mask branch combined via softmax weights.
formula: $$\hat y_i = \mathrm{Lin}_s^{(i)}(s_i)+\sigma(\alpha_i)\,T^{\text{slope}}_i+(1-\sigma(\alpha_i))\,\mathrm{Lin}_t^{(i)}(t_i),\quad \hat y_{\text{freq}}=\mathrm{Lin}_f\bigl(\mathcal{F}^{-1}(\sigma(m)\cdot\mathcal{F}(x))\bigr)$$ $$\hat y=\sum_{j}\mathrm{softmax}(w)_j\hat y_j+\text{de-Norm},\quad T^{\text{slope}}_i = t_i[-1]+\tfrac{t_i[-1]-\bar t_i^{(W_i)}}{W_i/2}\cdot[1..H]$$

key_hyperparams.name: slope_alpha
key_hyperparams.role: per-scale logit blending Lin trend ↔ slope extrap.

init_recovers: Average of 4 DLinears with no slope and uniform spectral pass at $\alpha_i=0,m=3.0,w=0$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces DLinear's single $k=25$ avg-pool decomposition with a 4-kernel cascade, adds an explicit local-slope extrapolation head per trend scale and a learnable spectral-mask linear branch — neither DLinear, TimesNet (2D conv on period blocks), PatchTST (patched transformer), nor TimeMixer's down/upsample mixing has both slope continuation and spectral filter combined this way.

name: Multi-scale decomp + frequency attention
tagline: series_decomp_multi at kernels {3,5,7}; per-scale seasonal branch uses softmax frequency-attention over first 16 modes plus DLinear-style head, trend uses DLinear; scales blended by learned softmax weights.

key_hyperparams.name: attn weights a_k
key_hyperparams.role: softmax attention over modes per channel

init_recovers: Multi-scale DLinear when attn=uniform and β=1
diff_from_baseline: Augments DLinear with multi-scale (3 kernels) decomposition like TimeMixer, but instead of cross-scale mixing uses learned softmax weights and adds a low-mode FFT attention block on the seasonal stream — TimesNet's 2D period conv and PatchTST's transformer are absent.

name: Spectral MoE residual stack
tagline: DLinear-style trend on a 25-kernel decomposition plus 3 N-BEATS-style residual blocks each containing a 3-expert spectral MoE (FFT amplitude → softmax gate, complex mask, iFFT) with backcast subtraction.

nodes.label: rFFT|·| → gate logits → softmax over 3 experts

diff_from_baseline: Differs from DLinear by stacking 3 N-BEATS-style residual blocks on top of the seasonal stream, where each block is a frequency-domain mixture-of-experts (3 experts gated by FFT amplitude); not TimesNet (no 2D period conv), not PatchTST (no patched attention), not TimeMixer (no down/up sampling cross-scale mix).

name: SRTM: feature-gated 4-head mixer
tagline: Last-value normalization, adaptive 3-kernel trend selected by residual energy, four DLinear-style heads (trend, residual, mixed, dominant-period repeat) gated by a 7-feature MLP plus a per-horizon learnable gate, with a horizon-decay shrinkage to trend.

nodes.label: 7 stats: trend strength, σ_r, σ_diff, σ_curv, peak, period/L, level

key_hyperparams.name: horizon decay
key_hyperparams.role: shrinkage to trend at long horizons

init_recovers: Equal mixture of trend/residual/mix DLinear heads when gates are uniform and slope/seasonal scales=0
diff_from_baseline: Differs from DLinear by adding three more heads (mixed-DLinear, local linear extrapolation, dominant-period FFT repeat) with feature-gated mixture, last-value anchoring, and horizon-aware shrinkage; lighter than TimesNet's 2D periodic conv, PatchTST's patched transformer, and TimeMixer's PDM blocks but introduces explicit signal-stat-driven gating not present in any baseline.
